title: ReportSpec
description: The verification spec stored in reports.spec once the report reaches `spec_ready`. Built by `spec_from_category`: the catalog row (frozen as category_versions.snapshot for catalog_version) plus what the LLM added. Every later step reads only this object: SAM grounding, the intake classifier, consensus, routing and the before/after closure. It is written once by the orchestrator (service_role) and reused when the photo is replaced or a closure is checked. All strings are English.

domain_id.description: The pair (domain_id, category_id) exists in domain_categories.

catalog_version.description: category_versions.version used to build this spec.

category_status.description: A `draft` category gives empty target_prompts and intake_status NOT_VERIFIABLE_NO_VISUAL_SPEC.

issue_description.description: What the problem looks like, read by the classifier.

resolved_description.description: What `resolved` looks like, read by the closure classifier.

context_prompts.description: Where to look (road, sidewalk). The zone is the convex hull of these masks. Empty = whole image.

target_prompts.description: Catalog target prompts followed by added_prompts.

extra_target_prompts.description: Wider deterioration phrases. Run only on the BEFORE photo and in widened search.

resolved_prompts.description: Evidence of a fix, used on the AFTER photo.

confuser_prompts.description: Shadow, water, vehicles: things that hide or mimic the problem.

count_prompts.description: From domains.count_prompts (e.g. `person` for transit). Empty = no counting.

added_prompts.description: The LLM's sam_prompts that survived validation and were appended to target_prompts. Kept apart so the catalog prompts stay auditable.

severity_proposed.description: The LLM's proposal. The final value lives in reports.severity.

source.description: llm = model answer accepted; keywords = deterministic catalog keyword match (fallback, or model confidence < 0.40); catalog = category forced (sandbox sample, admin reprocess).

llm.description: Present when a model was called, even if its answer was not used.

keyword_category.description: What the keyword matcher chose, for comparison.

prompt.description: Short English noun phrase for SAM 3.1 (lowercase, 1 to 5 words, no instructions).

examples.issue_description: a hole or broken depression in the asphalt with visible depth, loose material or exposed base
examples.resolved_description: the hole is filled: a flush asphalt patch or intact asphalt, with no depression
examples.vlm_hints: A fresh dark patch and a cast shadow look alike, and water inside a hole hides its depth. If unsure, answer uncertain.
examples.summary_en: Deep pothole in the right lane of Av. Cevallos near the market
